The misrepresentation must be a material one. This requirement is 
prominent in insurance litigation, where a misrepresentation 
by a policy

Various standards of materiality have been expressed, and while none is 
applied uniformly, they serve the common function of justifying a certain 
control by judges over the more volatile behavior of juries.
